⌈
When a Key-Value Storage or File Storage is
opened by the application using OpenKeyValueStorage or OpenFileStorage, or
when UpdatePersistency is called, the Persistency shall check for the existence
of stored data. If no persistent data is found, the Persistency shall initialize the
persistent data.
